bathymetry.limits: Published nearshore NOAA TopoBathy Merge resampled by producer to 2 m; separate MBARI 5 m grid not merged. 2 m is grid spacing, not per-cell precision. Mixed acquisition dates; interpolation mask unavailable; not independent of source contributors.
